name: __NAME__
description: Finds the files linked from a web page and offers them in the Add download dialog.
author: __AUTHOR__

reasons.network: Reads the pages whose addresses match the sites you list in the settings.
reasons.programs: Runs bin/probe.py (Python 3) to read a page and list the files it links to.

settings.label: Sites
settings.help: One address pattern per line. Pages that match are read by this extension, for example https://example.com/gallery/*.

settings.label: File types
settings.help: Comma-separated extensions of the links to offer.
